newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Kidston sees lower operating profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Kidston sees lower operating profit.

text.p: Kidston Gold Mines Ltd said on Thursday it expects to report a decline of over 15 percent in operating profits for calendar 1996 compared with 1995.

"As a result of operational factors which have been previously disclosed, the company believes that the operating profit for the year ended 31 December 1996 will be lower than the 1995 year by more than 15 percent," Kidston said.
Kidston had an operating profit of A$11.75 million in 1995.

"The company is in the process of finalising its year-end financial results, which it anticipates will be available for release in early February," the company said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
The statement was in response to an ASX query into fluctuations in the miner's share price between January 2 and 9.

Kidston said it was unaware of any reasons for the fluctuations. Kidston shares closed at A$1.70 on Thursday after retreating from a high of A$1.74. This compares with closing price of A$1.40 on January 2.
A fourth quarter production report is due out before January 31, Kidston said.
Kidston is owned 70 percent by Placer Pacific Ltd which in turn is owned 75.4 percent by Placer Dome Inc.
